title: La nena y las gafas
overview: In a dusty sandbox, between two construction workers who notice everything and a grandmother who notices nothing, Ramón and his daughter Lana argue over the little girl's glasses. Then someone shows up wearing the exact same pair: Diamante, a trans woman. Which side will Ramón choose—the workers or Diamante? The hard hat or the wig? Lana already knows the answer.
